description: Seam/binding patterns for the agent-review C4 gate (slice 2, decisions D4). Any cited ledger ID must match a known shape AND resolve to a ledger entry; genesis/identity/evidence records must be complete; expiry denies at-or-past cutoff (>=, never >); cross-repo contract pins must match; AVC bans new identifiers; memory is never authority.
